title: Oil change intervals and service guidance
summary: Feedback centers on oil change timing, service intervals, and confusion about required oil service or top-offs, with most examples not carrying a clear overall sentiment label.

positive.summary: One positive review notes difficulty accessing the menu to cycle consumables such as oil changes rather than praising the oil service itself.

negative.summary: One negative review describes poor post-sale support when asking about an oil slick and slight moisture issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly discuss oil change schedules, mileage thresholds, special oil requirements, and uncertainty about whether service visits are needed for top-offs, with some examples also expressing frustration about unexpectedly early oil service prompts.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, so the sentiment picture is limited.
Several undetermined fragments include frustration-like wording, but their assigned sentiment cannot be recast as negative here.
The cluster combines routine interval information, owner questions, and one post-sale support complaint, so the topic is only partly coherent.
